`spirit-domain.ethos` is the byte-for-byte canonical Interface projection from
the pinned `signal-domain` authority transaction. A Nix check compares both
files byte for byte.

`slice-one-newtype.ethos` is the compact Nexus header/imports/body witness for
unit, unary, and product lowering through the same current bootstrap train.

The former sealed Spirit batch fixture targeted a retired generated Rust domain
surface. It is intentionally not retained beside the current encoded
signal-domain authority.
